statement: Pinned xpadneo documentation says BLE-era non-Elite-Series-2 Xbox controller descriptors can advertise a Share usage despite some older Xbox One S hardware lacking that physical button. It also documents model 1708 Linux-mode descriptor examples of 306 and 334 bytes. These are upstream consumer comparators, not a verified firmware-to-descriptor matrix for every Xbox One revision.

applicability.revision: Xbox One S model 1708 Bluetooth, with explicit Series/Elite comparison and firmware uncertainty
applicability.scope: xpadneo docs/README.md:88-97; docs/descriptors/xb1s_linux.md:3-43; distinct xpadneo consumer lineage, not independent physical proof.
